تبتعثي (form VIII)
# تَبْتَعِثِي (tabtaʕiṯī) /tab.ta.ʕi.θiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# تُبْتَعَثِي (tubtaʕaṯī) /tub.ta.ʕa.θiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
